lines.t:
A <c:ffff00>Leg Type<c> that flies high in the air. Its <c:ffff00>{{stats}}<c> tend
toward high <c:ffff00>{{mobility}}<c>, but low <c:ffff00>{{armor}}<c> and <c:ffff00>Heavy<c>
<c:ffff00>Limit<c>. It isn't affected by ground shape, but
struggles in enclosed {{terrain}}.

<c:ffff00>{{terrain|cap}} {{affinity|cap}}<c> ({{mobility}}, <c:ffff00>{{fighting}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{shooting}}<c>):
  <c:ffff00>{{plains}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{forest}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{rocky_ground}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{tundra}}<c>: 0.
  <c:ffff00>{{sand}}<c> +6, <c:ffff00>{{hall}}<c> -4, <c:ffff00>{{waterside}}<c> -6, <c:ffff00>{{sky}}<c> +6, <c:ffff00>{{cyber}}<c> +4.
  <c:ffff00>{{underwater}}<c>: {{robattle|pl}} not possible.
